tours.name: Mountain Trekking, 6 Days
tours.meta: Trekking · 6 days · Challenging · Up to 8 people per group
about: A six-day route through highland Svaneti — one of Georgia's most remote and scenic regions. We walk through alpine meadows, medieval tower villages, and mountain passes with views of the Ushba and Shkhara glaciers.
The group is small, and the route is built for people who already have multi-day trekking experience. We stay in guesthouses and a tent camp, with all meals included.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Mestia
itinerary.description: Transfer from Tbilisi, check in at a guesthouse, an acclimatization walk around town, and a briefing with your guide.

itinerary.title: Mestia — Zhabeshi
itinerary.description: The route begins across alpine meadows, past the first tower village, with an overnight stay at a guesthouse.

itinerary.title: Zhabeshi — Adishi
itinerary.description: Cross a pass with views of the Chalaadi glacier, ford a river, and camp at the foot of the mountains.

itinerary.title: Adishi — Ushguli
itinerary.description: Europe's highest inhabited settlement, with views of Shkhara — Georgia's tallest peak.

itinerary.title: Side trip day
itinerary.description: An easier day for rest and acclimatization, with a walk to a glacier viewpoint.

itinerary.title: Ushguli — Mestia — Tbilisi
itinerary.description: Transfer back, free time, and a flight home the next day.

tours.name: Tuscan Cuisine & Vineyards
tours.meta: Culinary · 5 days · Easy · Up to 10 people per group
about: A five-day food and wine journey through the Tuscan hills, from the Chianti vineyards to the farmhouses of the Val d'Orcia. The days are slow: short drives, long lunches, and tastings with the families who make the wine and olive oil.
The group is small and the pace is easy, so no hiking experience is needed. We stay in family-run farmhouses, cook together one afternoon, and all meals are included.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Florence — Siena
itinerary.description: Meet in Florence, drive to Siena, check in at a farmhouse, and enjoy a welcome dinner of Tuscan classics.

itinerary.title: Chianti vineyards
itinerary.description: A morning walk between the vines, a cellar visit and tasting at a family winery, then a long lunch with local cheeses and cured meats.

itinerary.title: Val d'Orcia — cooking class
itinerary.description: Drive through the Val d'Orcia hills to a farmhouse kitchen, where you make fresh pasta and a Tuscan dessert and eat what you cook.

itinerary.title: San Gimignano — Montalcino
itinerary.description: Explore the medieval towers of San Gimignano, then taste Brunello in Montalcino and visit an olive oil producer on the way back.

itinerary.title: Market and departure
itinerary.description: Shop at a local market for olive oil, honey, and pecorino, have a last breakfast together, and transfer back to Florence.

included: All meals as described in the itinerary
Wine tastings and the cooking class

tours.name: From the Medina to the Atlas Mountains
tours.meta: Cultural Immersion · 7 days · Moderate · Up to 10 people per group
about: A seven-day route from the markets of Marrakech over the High Atlas to the edge of the Sahara. We wander through medinas, cross the Tizi n'Tichka pass, walk in the Dadès valley, and spend two nights in a desert camp.
The days are varied, with some long drives and easy walks of two to three hours. We stay in riads, small guesthouses, and a desert camp, and all breakfasts and dinners are included.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Marrakech
itinerary.description: Meet at your hotel, settle into a riad in the medina, and finish the day with dinner on a rooftop terrace.

itinerary.title: Marrakech medina
itinerary.description: A guided walk through the souks, the Bahia Palace, and Jemaa el-Fnaa square, with time for mint tea and shopping.

itinerary.title: Over the High Atlas
itinerary.description: Drive across the Tizi n'Tichka pass, stop in a Berber village for a short walk and tea, and spend the night near Aït Benhaddou.

itinerary.title: Aït Benhaddou — Dadès Gorge
itinerary.description: Explore the UNESCO-listed ksar in the morning, then drive through the Valley of Roses to the Dadès Gorge for an evening walk.

itinerary.title: Dadès — Merzouga
itinerary.description: Walk in the Todra Gorge, drive to the edge of the Sahara, and ride camels at sunset into your desert camp.

itinerary.title: Desert camp
itinerary.description: Watch the sunrise from the dunes, visit a nomad family, and spend a second night under the stars.

itinerary.title: Merzouga — Marrakech
itinerary.description: A long scenic drive back to Marrakech, with stops along the way and a farewell dinner in the evening.

included: Entrance fees to sites on the route
notIncluded: Tips for the guide and driver

tours.name: The Inca Trail to Machu Picchu
tours.meta: Trekking · 5 days · Challenging · Up to 8 people per group
about: A five-day route to Machu Picchu on the classic Inca Trail, through cloud forest, high passes, and stone-paved Inca paths. We cross Dead Woman's Pass at 4,215 m and reach the Sun Gate at sunrise.

The group is small, and you should be comfortable walking five to eight hours a day at altitude. We camp on the trail with a guide, a cook, and porters, and the first day in Cusco is for acclimatization.

itinerary.title: Cusco — acclimatization
itinerary.description: Arrive in Cusco at 3,400 m, rest, and take an easy walk through the old town and the Sacsayhuamán ruins with your guide.

itinerary.title: Km 82 — Wayllabamba
itinerary.description: Drive to the trailhead, cross the Cusichaca valley, and climb gently to the first campsite, about 11 km.

itinerary.title: Dead Woman's Pass
itinerary.description: The hardest day: a long climb to Dead Woman's Pass at 4,215 m, then a steep descent to the Pacaymayo valley.

itinerary.title: Cloud forest — Wiñay Wayna
itinerary.description: Cross the Runkurakay pass, walk through cloud forest past Sayacmarca and Phuyupatamarca, and camp near Wiñay Wayna.

itinerary.title: Machu Picchu at sunrise
itinerary.description: Wake before dawn, walk to the Sun Gate for the first view of Machu Picchu, then tour the site and take the train back.

included: Hotel in Cusco and camping on the trail
Inca Trail permit and Machu Picchu entrance ticket
notIncluded: Tips for the guide, cook, and porters

tours.name: Traditional Crafts & Temples
tours.meta: Cultural Immersion · 8 days · Easy · Up to 10 people per group
about: An eight-day journey through Japan's craft traditions, from the workshops of old Tokyo to the temples of Kyoto and the gold-leaf studios of Kanazawa. You try the crafts yourself and meet the people who still practice them.
The pace is easy: short walks, trains between cities, and time to rest every day. We stay in comfortable hotels and one traditional ryokan, and breakfasts are included.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Tokyo
itinerary.description: Meet at your hotel, take a short orientation walk around the neighborhood, and share a welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: Asakusa — Tokyo crafts
itinerary.description: Visit Sensō-ji temple, then try a traditional craft in an Asakusa workshop, such as indigo dyeing or woodblock printing.

itinerary.title: Tokyo — Kyoto by shinkansen
itinerary.description: Take the bullet train to Kyoto in about two hours and a quarter, check in, and stroll through the lantern-lit streets of Gion.

itinerary.title: Temples of Kyoto
itinerary.description: Walk through the thousand torii gates of Fushimi Inari, then visit Kiyomizu-dera and the Golden Pavilion, Kinkaku-ji.

itinerary.title: Arashiyama — tea ceremony
itinerary.description: Walk through the Arashiyama bamboo grove in the morning, then learn the basics of a tea ceremony from a tea master.

itinerary.title: Nara
itinerary.description: A day trip to Nara to see Tōdai-ji and its giant Buddha, and to walk among the deer in Nara Park.

itinerary.title: Kyoto — Kanazawa
itinerary.description: Take the train to Kanazawa, visit Kenroku-en garden, and try gold-leaf craft, the city's specialty, in a workshop. Tonight you stay in a ryokan.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Have a last breakfast together and transfer to the station for your onward journey.

included: Hotels and one night in a ryokan

tours.name: Wine & Cuisine of the Douro Valley
tours.meta: Culinary · 5 days · Easy · Up to 10 people per group
about: Five days in Portugal's oldest wine region, from the lively streets of Porto to the terraced vineyards of the Douro Valley. We taste port and table wines at family estates, ride the scenic river train, and cruise between the terraces.
The pace is relaxed, with short transfers and plenty of time at the table. We stay in a boutique hotel in Porto and on a wine estate in the valley, and all meals are included.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Porto
itinerary.description: Meet in Porto, walk down to the Ribeira waterfront, and visit a port wine lodge in Vila Nova de Gaia for a first tasting.

itinerary.title: Douro Valley by train
itinerary.description: Ride the scenic Douro Line upriver, then drive to your wine estate for dinner among the vineyards.

itinerary.title: Tasting at a quinta
itinerary.description: Walk through the terraced vineyards with the winemaker, then taste estate wines over a long lunch of regional dishes.

itinerary.title: Douro river cruise
itinerary.description: Cruise along the river through the terraced valley, stop in a village for lunch, and return to the estate by road.

itinerary.title: Porto market and departure
itinerary.description: Visit the Bolhão market for cheese, cured meats, and pastries, then have a farewell lunch before departing.

included: Boutique hotel in Porto and a wine estate
All meals as described in the itinerary
Tastings at wineries and port lodges
Douro train ticket and river cruise
notIncluded: Wine and food bought for yourself

tours.name: Annapurna Base Camp
tours.meta: Trekking · 10 days · Challenging · Up to 8 people per group
about: A ten-day trek to the foot of the Annapurna massif, a classic Himalayan route that climbs from rhododendron forest to the glacier basin at 4,130 m. We walk between Gurung villages and finish with views of Annapurna I, Machapuchare, and Hiunchuli.

The trek is demanding but suits strong walkers with no technical experience, with five to seven hours on the trail each day. We stay in simple teahouses, a guide and a porter carry the load, and the trek ends with a hot-spring soak at Jhinu Danda.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu — Pokhara
itinerary.description: Fly from Kathmandu to Pokhara, meet your guide, and enjoy a lakeside evening while the team checks your gear.

itinerary.title: Pokhara — Nayapul — Ghandruk
itinerary.description: Drive to Nayapul and begin the trek, climbing stone steps along the Modi Khola to the Gurung village of Ghandruk.

itinerary.title: Ghandruk — Chhomrong
itinerary.description: Cross forested ridges and a suspension bridge to Chhomrong, the last big village on the route, with views of Annapurna South.

itinerary.title: Chhomrong — Dovan
itinerary.description: Descend to the river and climb through bamboo and rhododendron forest to the small settlement of Dovan.

itinerary.title: Dovan — Machapuchare Base Camp
itinerary.description: Climb through Himalaya and Deurali into the high valley, where the fishtail peak of Machapuchare rises above your camp.

itinerary.title: Annapurna Base Camp
itinerary.description: A short walk up to the base camp at 4,130 m, with the whole amphitheater of peaks around you and the afternoon to enjoy it.

itinerary.title: Annapurna Base Camp — Bamboo
itinerary.description: Watch the sunrise on the peaks, then begin the long descent through the valley to Bamboo.

itinerary.title: Bamboo — Jhinu Danda
itinerary.description: Walk down through Chhomrong to Jhinu Danda and soak your legs in the natural hot springs by the river.

itinerary.title: Jhinu Danda — Nayapul — Pokhara
itinerary.description: Walk out to Nayapul, then drive back to Pokhara for a hot shower and a celebration dinner.

itinerary.title: Pokhara — Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Take a morning flight back to Kathmandu, with time to rest before your onward journey.

included: Hotel in Pokhara and teahouses on the trek
notIncluded: Tips for the guide and porter
Extra drinks, hot showers, and device charging

tours.name: Mezcal, Markets & Street Food
tours.meta: Culinary · 5 days · Easy · Up to 12 people per group
about: A five-day food trip through Oaxaca's markets, mezcal distilleries, and village kitchens. We eat our way from street-corner tlayudas to a hands-on mole class, and learn how agave becomes mezcal.
The pace is easy and the walks are short. We stay in a small hotel in Oaxaca's historic center, and most meals are included, though you will want to leave room for the market.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Oaxaca
itinerary.description: Check in at your hotel in the historic center, walk to the Zócalo, and start with a street-food dinner of tlayudas and local snacks.

itinerary.title: Santiago Matatlán — mezcal
itinerary.description: Visit a family palenque in Santiago Matatlán, the "world capital of mezcal", see the agave roasted and distilled, and taste the results.

itinerary.title: Teotitlán del Valle
itinerary.description: Meet Zapotec weavers in Teotitlán del Valle, learn how they dye wool with natural pigments, and have lunch in a family home.

itinerary.title: Hierve el Agua — mole class
itinerary.description: Walk and swim at the petrified waterfalls of Hierve el Agua, then cook a traditional mole with a local chef in the afternoon.

itinerary.title: Mitla — departure
itinerary.description: Explore the Zapotec ruins of Mitla in the morning, then transfer to the airport or bus station.

included: Breakfasts and most lunches and dinners
Mezcal tastings and the mole class

tours.name: Islands & Old Coastal Towns
tours.meta: Nature · 7 days · Moderate · Up to 12 people per group
about: A seven-day journey along Croatia's Dalmatian coast, linking old stone towns, island coves, and a national park. We move between Split, Hvar, Korčula, and Dubrovnik by ferry, with plenty of time for swimming, short hikes, and seafood.
The days are active but not hard, with a few hours of walking and one day of sea kayaking. We stay in small hotels and guesthouses in old towns, and breakfasts are included.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Split
itinerary.description: Meet in Split, explore Diocletian's Palace with your guide, and have dinner on the seafront promenade.

itinerary.title: Krka National Park
itinerary.description: Walk the boardwalks past the Skradinski Buk waterfalls and take a boat to the island monastery of Visovac.

itinerary.title: Split — Hvar
itinerary.description: Take the morning ferry to Hvar, check in at your guesthouse in the old town, and climb to the fortress for sunset.

itinerary.title: Hvar coast
itinerary.description: Paddle by sea kayak along the coast to quiet coves, stop for a swim and lunch, and return to Hvar town in the afternoon.

itinerary.title: Hvar — Korčula
itinerary.description: Take a ferry to Korčula, walk the walls of the old town, and taste the local white wine made from the Pošip grape.

itinerary.title: Korčula — Dubrovnik
itinerary.description: Cross by boat to Dubrovnik, walk the city walls in the late afternoon light, and have dinner in the old town.

itinerary.title: Elaphiti Islands
itinerary.description: Take a boat to the Elaphiti Islands, walk between villages on Šipan or Lopud, swim, and share a farewell seafood lunch.

notIncluded: Flights to Split and from Dubrovnik

tours.name: Desert & Ancient Cities
tours.meta: Cultural Immersion · 6 days · Moderate · Up to 10 people per group
about: A six-day journey through Jordan's most famous places: the Roman ruins of Jerash, the rock-cut city of Petra, the red desert of Wadi Rum, and a float in the Dead Sea. We hike, ride in a 4x4, and sleep one night under the desert stars.

The route suits anyone in good health, with up to six hours of walking in Petra and some steps to climb. We stay in comfortable hotels and one Bedouin camp, and all breakfasts and most dinners are included.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Amman
itinerary.description: Meet at your hotel, take a short walk through the downtown souks, and share a welcome dinner of local mezze.

itinerary.title: Amman — Jerash — Petra
itinerary.description: Visit the Roman ruins of Jerash, then drive south along the King's Highway to Petra.

itinerary.title: Petra — the Siq
itinerary.description: Walk through the narrow Siq canyon to the Treasury, then explore the Royal Tombs, the Street of Facades, and the theater.

itinerary.title: Petra — the Monastery
itinerary.description: Climb about 800 steps to Ad Deir, the Monastery, for a quieter view over the valley, then walk back through the ruins.

itinerary.title: Wadi Rum
itinerary.description: Drive to Wadi Rum, ride in a 4x4 across the red desert, watch the sunset from the dunes, and sleep in a Bedouin camp.

itinerary.title: Wadi Rum — Dead Sea
itinerary.description: Drive north to the Dead Sea for a float in the salt water and a mud treatment before the trip ends.

included: Hotels and one night in a Bedouin camp
Entrance tickets to Petra and Jerash

tours.name: Fjords & Mountain Trails
tours.meta: Nature · 6 days · Moderate · Up to 8 people per group
about: A six-day journey through western Norway's fjord country, from the old wooden wharf of Bergen to the UNESCO-listed Nærøyfjord and the orchards of Hardanger. We travel by train, kayak, and on foot, with mountain trails and waterfalls along the way.
The route is active but suits anyone used to a full day outdoors, with up to six hours of hiking on the longest day. We stay in small hotels and fjord-side guesthouses, and breakfasts are included.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bergen
itinerary.description: Meet in Bergen, walk along the wooden wharf of Bryggen, and ride the Fløibanen funicular for the view over the city.

itinerary.title: Bergen — Flåm
itinerary.description: Take the scenic train to Myrdal, then ride the Flåm Railway down the mountainside to the fjord.

itinerary.title: Nærøyfjord by kayak
itinerary.description: Paddle the narrow, UNESCO-listed Nærøyfjord beneath steep cliffs and waterfalls, with a picnic lunch on the shore.

itinerary.title: Flåm — Hardangerfjord
itinerary.description: Drive through the mountains to the Hardangerfjord, with stops at the Vøringsfossen waterfall and a fruit farm.

itinerary.title: Hardanger mountain hike
itinerary.description: A full-day hike on a mountain trail above the fjord, with views over the water and the Folgefonna glacier.

itinerary.title: Hardanger — Bergen
itinerary.description: Drive back to Bergen, spend free time at the Fish Market, and share a farewell dinner.

included: Train from Bergen and Flåm Railway tickets

tours.name: From Mountain Villages to the River Delta
tours.meta: Nature · 8 days · Moderate · Up to 12 people per group
about: An eight-day journey across Vietnam, from the terraced mountains around Sapa to the limestone bay of Ha Long and the canals of the Mekong Delta. We walk between hill-tribe villages, sleep in a homestay, and travel by train, boat, and a short flight.
The walking days are moderate, with four to six hours on village paths. We stay in hotels, a family homestay, and one night on a boat, and breakfasts are included.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi
itinerary.description: Meet at your hotel in the Old Quarter, take a short walk to Hoan Kiem Lake, and share a welcome dinner of Hanoi specialties.

itinerary.title: Hanoi — Sapa
itinerary.description: Travel north to Sapa by train and minibus, check in, and take an evening walk around the town above the clouds.

itinerary.title: Lao Chai — Ta Van
itinerary.description: Hike through rice terraces and bamboo forest to the villages of Lao Chai and Ta Van, and spend the night in a family homestay.

itinerary.title: Bac Ha market
itinerary.description: Drive to Bac Ha, one of the region's biggest and most colorful markets, and walk among stalls of local textiles and produce.

itinerary.title: Return to Hanoi
itinerary.description: Take a last morning walk in Sapa, then travel back to Hanoi for the evening.

itinerary.title: Ha Long Bay cruise
itinerary.description: Drive to Ha Long Bay, board a traditional boat, cruise past limestone islands, kayak, and spend the night on board.

itinerary.title: Ha Long — Ho Chi Minh City
itinerary.description: Enjoy the bay at sunrise, return to Hanoi, and take an evening flight to Ho Chi Minh City.

itinerary.title: Mekong Delta
itinerary.description: Drive to the delta, travel by boat through the canals, taste tropical fruit, and return to Ho Chi Minh City by evening.

included: Hotels, a homestay, and one night on a boat
Train, boat, and domestic flight tickets
